story_overview: MSVBench story 68 (Greek Mythology). Narrator: On the distant island of Crete, there lived an extraordinarily brilliant architect named Daedalus. Fearing the labyrinth's secrets might be revealed, the king imprisoned Daedalus and his son Icarus in a high tower within the labyrinth. Icarus, flying for the first time, forgot his father's warning and flew higher and higher. Eventually, the wax wings melted from the sun's heat, causing him to plummet from the sky.

video_prompts: Daytime, seaside cliffs of Crete, serene atmosphere, vast blue sea in the distance with waves gently lapping against the rocks. Sparse shrubs and wildflowers grow on the cliffs, seagulls circle in the sky, soft natural lighting. No characters present. Narrator: On the distant island of Crete, there lived an extraordinarily brilliant architect named Daedalus. Wide shot, eye level shot.

Daytime, inside the labyrinth, gloomy atmosphere, stone walls covered with ivy, moss growing on the ground. Flickering light streams through narrow windows, faint echoes resonate from the depths of the labyrinth, dim lighting. Daedalus stands at the center of the labyrinth, his expression focused, holding design blueprints in his hand as he surveys the surrounding walls. Daedalus, commissioned by King Minos, built an incredibly complex labyrinth. Medium shot, high-angle shot.

Daytime, inside the high tower of the labyrinth, oppressive atmosphere, dim lighting inside the stone tower with only a small window letting in faint light. The interior is sparsely furnished, with clutter piled in a corner, dim lighting. Daedalus and Icarus stand inside the tower, Daedalus looking grave and Icarus uneasy, both gazing at the small window. Fearing the labyrinth's secrets might be revealed, the king imprisoned Daedalus and his son Icarus in a high tower within the labyrinth. Full shot, low-angle shot.

Daytime, inside the high tower, tense atmosphere, workbench scattered with tools and materials, design blueprints hanging on the wall. The distant sea is visible through the window, bright lighting. Daedalus holds the newly completed wings, speaking seriously to Icarus as the latter listens attentively, his eyes gleaming with excitement. Daedalus meticulously designed a pair of wings and warned his son Icarus not to fly too low or too high. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, high in the sky, tense atmosphere, azure sky dotted with white clouds, vast sea glistening under the sunlight below, intense sunlight. Icarus flies through the air, his expression excited as the wings begin to melt. He looks up at the sun in terror as his body starts to fall. Icarus, flying for the first time, forgot his father's warning and flew higher and higher. Eventually, the wax wings melted from the sun's heat, causing him to plummet from the sky. Frontal, dutch angle shot.
